items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And then he brought a singer, by the name of Joe Williams, or something like that.

ctx.x: We got Willie Scott later. But they

had a guy playing baritone. So we had a trumpet, a tenor, alto and baritone. As the rhythm section. And then he brought a singer, by the name of Joe Williams, or something like that. And that job, we immediately began to get trouble from the white local in Kansas City, 34. They started saying that according to a zoning law they made up right quickly, we were out of our territory.
You were separate then, black and white?
